entities.summary: Gérard Pettipas, C.Ss.R. is a Canadian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He is a member of the Congregation of the Most Holy Redeemer (Redemptorists). He was archbishop of the Archdiocese of Grouard-McLennan from 2006 to 2025.
